defects.problem: The yellow highlight begins offset to the left of 'ShowMe' covering only the 'S', which looks misaligned in the first frame.
defects.fix: Start the wipe flush to the left edge of the word box.

defects.problem: Two URLs carry the same weight and size, so there is no single clear call to action; 'Where do I press?' is tiny.
defects.fix: Make the app URL larger than the GitHub line, with no new elements.

defects.problem: The card is plain with a large empty left and right margin; the close is correct but reads as a template.
defects.fix: Scale the lockup up to fill the card more.

defects.problem: 'AI-generated narration.' is micro text, unreadable at feed size.
defects.fix: Enlarge it slightly or fold it into the main caption.

oneLineVerdict: Clean, stable, readable end card, but generic, with the call to action undifferentiated.
